info.name: LeviMusic - Aurelis Online
info.author: Liliyana Rea de Aurelis
info.summary: Client-side music player with synchronized 2D and 3D world lyrics for LeviLauncher Android. Full mode requires the Bridge APK.
info.description: LeviMusic adds music search, playback, an editable Up Next queue, user playlists, word-synchronized lyrics, romanization, and client-only 3D floating lyrics to Minecraft Bedrock on LeviLauncher Android ARM64. Full mode uses the matching LeviMusic Bridge APK. Standalone connects to the hosted Aurelis Symphony API and does not require an APK or user-run server, but it does need internet access. Native 3D world lyrics require a matching Minecraft ARM64 Build ID; the 1.26.66.1 exact binary profile is included but its runtime behavior is not yet verified.

labels.LeviMusic-1.5.1-arm64-v8a.levipack: Full mod — install the matching Bridge APK

changelog: v1.5.1 stable: Adds a Minecraft 1.26.66.1 ARM64 renderer profile. Device runtime behavior for 1.26.66.1 remains unverified and may be less stable.
